Message.Name: Logon Message
Message.Description: The first message the order management system sends to the trading gateway, which confirms a successful logon with a Logon of its own, so both sides transmit this message type.

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Heartbeat interval in seconds, given by the order management system at logon

Field.Name: DefaultApplVerID
Field.Description: Binary protocol version, the communication version number written as n.xy

Message.Name: Logout Message
Message.Description: Sent by the trading gateway to refuse a logon, and by either side to end the session; the receiver answers with a Logout of its own, so both sides transmit this message type.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Further explanation of the logout reason, up to 200 bytes that may include Chinese characters

Message.Name: Heartbeat Message
Message.Description: Sent by either side when idle so that no more than one heartbeat interval passes between messages; the body is empty.

Message.Name: Business Reject Message
Message.Description: Sent by the trading gateway when a submission fails a basic validity check, such as an unknown security code or a submission outside its time window.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Security code, 6 digits behind 2 leading spaces

Field.Name: SecurityIDSource
Field.Description: Security code source, 3 digits behind a leading space

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: Message sequence number of the rejected message

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: Message type of the rejected message

Field.Name: BusinessRejectRefID
Field.Description: Business layer ID of the rejected message: ClOrdID for a new order, an order cancel request or a quote response, QuoteMsgID for a quote, TradeReportID for a trade capture report

Field.Name: BusinessRejectText
Field.Description: Reject reason text, up to 50 bytes that may include Chinese characters

Message.Name: Report Synchronization Message
Message.Description: Sent by the order management system after logon to give, for each platform partition, the record number of the next report it expects; the gateway sends no reports for a partition the message omits.

Field.Name: PartitionReports
Field.Description: One entry per platform partition the order management system expects to receive

Message.Name: Platform State Info Message
Message.Description: Sent by the trading gateway after logon and whenever a platform changes state, so the order management system can control when it submits orders.

Message.Name: Report Finished Message
Message.Description: Sent by the trading gateway when every report of the trading day for a platform partition has been sent; its record number continues the numbering of the partition's reports.

Field.Name: ReportIndex
Field.Description: Report record number, continuing the numbering of the partition's reports

Message.Name: Platform Info Message
Message.Description: Sent by the trading gateway after logon, giving the number of partitions of the platform and their numbers, which need not be consecutive.

Message.Name: Trading Session Status Message
Message.Description: Sent by the trading gateway after logon and whenever the trading session of the connected platform changes; only the fixed income platform currently sends it.

Field.Name: MarketSegmentID
Field.Description: Market segment code; only the first character is used, giving the platform: 2 = fixed income platform

Field.Name: TradingSessionSubID
Field.Description: Trading session sub ID, a numeric string
